about.title: About
about.heroTitle: A sewing office that quotes MOQ before it cuts.
about.heroDescription: Knit and woven in Shaoxing and Guangzhou. Send a tech pack or a reference garment. We date the sample and cut after PP.
about.workflowDescription: Construction and monthly volume pick the factory. PP picks the cutting week.
about.closingDescription: Send the pack or a garment photo. MOQ per style/color and a sample date in 48 hours.

contact.title: Contact
contact.heroTitle: Write to the merchandiser on the style.
contact.heroDescription: Fit sample, size run or a bulk PO — one person dates it.

collections.title: Styles
collections.heroDescription: Knit tops, woven shirts, outerwear, activewear, uniforms, private label.
collections.benefitsDescription: Factory, MOQ per style/color, sample date, whether sample fee is deductible.
collections.stylesDescription: Retail floors, staff uniforms, gyms, brand drops.

brands.title: For brands
brands.description: Keep the signed block on the repeat.
brands.content: First bulk often misses the signed fit. We grade from that sample and keep the factory assignment so a repeat order does not start a new pattern.

retailers.title: For retailers
retailers.content: If 500 pcs / color is too high for a test, we quote from about 100 pcs per style/color and a short size set. Hangtags and carton marks go on the PO before cutting.

agents.title: For agents
agents.description: Sample date and cutting week in writing.
agents.content: Deposit without a dated slot is how orders slip. The merchandiser puts the PP date and the cutting week in the same mail.

size-specs.title: Size specifications
size-specs.content: Send a chart or a fit sample. We grade XS–4XL. Bulk does not cut until the base is signed.

sampling.title: Sampling
sampling.description: No tech pack? Send a garment.
sampling.content: A reference garment plus size range opens a quote. First sample is about 7 days if fabric is here. Proto, fit, then PP. Sample fee comes off bulk.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: BSCI and the audit you name.
certifications.content: We place the style in a factory that already holds the audit. The file goes with the quote, not after the deposit.

quality-control.title: Quality control
quality-control.content: Final audit: measurements against the signed spec, stitch, appearance, carton count. Report signed before the truck.

how-it-works.title: How it works
how-it-works.content: Send pack or garment → quote MOQ and sample date → sign fit → sign PP → sew → AQL. Same merchandiser.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.content: Typical MOQ from 100 pcs per style/color. First sample about 7 days. Sample fee deductible on the first PO. Deposit and AQL level written before the bulk PO.

workflow.description: Measure on the line, count at the door.
